CITY OF ALHAMBRA
  AGENDA

  ENVIRONMENTAL SUSTAINABILITY COMMISSION
  JULY 14, 2022
  MISSION STATEMENT
  The City of Alhambra is dedicated to responsive, creative leadership and quality
  services, ensuring desirable neighborhoods and a supportive business
  environment, while being sensitive to the diversity of our community.

  CORONAVIRUS (COVID-19) ADVISORY NOTICE
Consistent with AB 361, the Alhambra Environmental Sustainability Commission special meeting will
not be physically open to the public, although the public may participate by video conference or
teleconference and all Commission members will participate via video conference or teleconference
rather than in person.

Watch and listen to the meeting via Zoom Webinar as follows:

Zoom Webinar direct link:
https://cityofalhambra-org.zoom.us/j/89855782732?pwd=YjRQWHJGRDVISzdrcy9BdGQ5NjBxQT09

Meeting ID: 898 5578 2732, Passcode: 331503

Or by telephone by dialing 888-475-4499 (Toll Free) or 833-548-0276 (Toll Free) or 833-548-0282 (Toll
Free) or 877-853-5257 (Toll Free) or 1-669-900-9128 or 1-346-248-7799 or 1-253-215-8782 or 1-646-558-
8656 or 1-301-715-8592 or 1-312-626-6799 and entering Meeting ID: 898 5578 2732 and Passcode:
331503. Please Note: All members of the public calling or logging into the meeting will be muted so that
the meeting can proceed.

Addressing the Alhambra Environmental Sustainability Commission

Via Zoom or Telephone: “Raise your hand” - Members of the public may speak by using the “Raise Hand”
function during the public comments portion, if on Zoom or telephone. Staff will unmute speakers
participating via Zoom or telephone and announce your name when it is your time to speak.

Remarks are limited to 5 minutes; however, the presiding officer may either extend or reduce the
maximum time to such period of time as the Commission may determine.

   CITY OF ALHAMBRA
  AGENDA
  REGULAR MEETING
  ALHAMBRA ENVIRONMENTAL SUSTAINABILITY COMMISSION

  City Hall, 111 South First Street
  JULY 14, 2022
  6:00 p.m.

  I.  ROLL CALL
  John Vuong, Kim Luu, Katie Chan, Karla Grijalva

  II.  ELECTION OF OFFICERS
  Each year the Commission is appointed by the City Council. At this time, it is appropriate to conduct
  an election to determine which members will chair the meeting as president and in the event the
  chair cannot attend the meeting, determine which member will step in as Vice President to conduct
  the meeting.
  Recommended Action: That the Commission elect a new president and vice president to chair the
  meeting.

  III.  DICUSSION OF COMMISSION DUTIES
  Commission Members will discuss their newly assigned duties by the City Council and create
  agenda items for future meetings.
  Recommended Action: Develop agenda items for the next meeting.

  IV.  STORMWATER CAPTURE PROJECTS OVERVIEW
  Deputy Director David Dolphin will give an update on the development of the feasibility studies for
  the Green Street Demonstration Project on Main St at Fremont Ave and the Burke Heritage Park
  and Marengo Yard Project.
  Recommended Action: Information only. No action required.

  V.  PUBLIC COMMENTS
  Discussion from the public of any item not specified on the agenda. Comments are welcome, but
  must pertain to the business of the Alhambra Environmental Sustainability Commission. Please limit
  all oral communication to five (5) minutes. Speakers must fill out a blue speaker’s card, prior to the
  meeting and submit it to the Commission Secretary. Comments must pertain to the business of the
  Environmental Sustainability Commission. Please limit all oral communications to five (5) minutes.

  VI.  COMMISSION COMMUNICATION
  Discussion from the Commission Members of any item not specified on the agenda. Items must
  pertain to the business of the Alhambra Environmental Sustainability Commission.

  VII.  ADJOURNMENT
  Adjournment to the next regular meeting on Thursday, September 8, 2022 at 6:00 p.m.

  Copies of staff reports or other written documentation, if any, relating to each item of business described
  above are on file in the Alhambra City Hall, Public Works Department, 111 S. First Street, Alhambra
  California 91801 and are available for public inspection upon request during regular business hours of
  7:00am to 5:30pm, Monday through Thursday.

  Should any person have a question concerning any of the above agenda items prior to the meeting
  described herein, he or she may contact David Dolphin, Deputy Director of Utilities, either in person at the
  Utilities Department at Alhambra City Hall, 111 South First Street, or by calling via telephone at (626) 570-
  5067 during regular business hours.
